verdict.rationale: Vast.ai is a GPU cloud platform, so an official MCP server is a fair capability to ask about. The evidence shows only a `vastai` agent skill installed into coding agents, plus a CLI, SDK and REST API. None of these is a documented MCP server, and an agent skill is an adjacent feature that earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
